item.description: Jilles Groskamp posted up a video this week where he has attached four individual motors at each hub of his Infinity touring car eliminating all of the rest of the drivetrain components. Check out what he came up with here!

item.title: New Hudy Aluminum Touring Car Setup Wheels
item.description: Hudy has released aluminum set-up wheels designed for precise and repeatable tweak adjustment on 1/10 Touring Car and FWD chassis.

item.title: New Team Xray Aluminum XB2 Extra Low Position Hub
item.description: Team Xray has released new aluminum rear upright featuring an extra-lower suspension arm mounting position for the 1/10th scale off-road vehicles.

item.title: New Infinity IF8B EV 1/8th Electric Buggy Platform
item.description: This is the electric evolution of the IFB8 platform. Built on the proven IFB8 drivetrain and suspension, the car has been developed through extensive prototype testing and real-world race competition.

item.title: New Factory Team RC8 Droop Gauge
item.description: Introducing the new Factory Team RC8 droop gauge, 70-135mm! Conveniently slip the top of this item over the top shock nut and line up the bottom with the shock pin to give yourself an easy measurement.
